rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a usable day-5 blastocyst and the reported 3BA, but it incorrectly interprets 3BA as A-level ICM and B-level TE; in standard Gardner notation 3BA means B ICM and A TE. Some image-specific details are also somewhat generic.

Integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, and semen parameters, with reasonable linkage to prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions broadly supported by the case data. The main weakness is the grading misinterpretation and somewhat conservative probability estimates relative to the favorable age.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, avoids unsupported add-ons, emphasizes luteal support and uterine evaluation after repeated failures. Minor deviation comes from the grading error and some speculative emphasis on sperm DNA fragmentation.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, avoiding bed rest, and when to consider cavity assessment, endometriosis review, and PGT-A. Useful though not highly tailored to fresh vs frozen specifics.
